about: Where tapping each notification opens in the app. Read by api/internal/notifications/routes_test.go, which fails when the server can create a type or subject kind missing here, and by ios/DinnerOSTests/NotificationRoutingTests.swift, which fails when the app has no route for a row. Destinations: pantry_item (Pantry tab, the item), pantry_thaw (Pantry tab, Take Out to Thaw), shop_week (Shop tab, that week), recipe_import (Household tab, Recipe Import).
